the procedure described here can be used for detecting dsRNA in virus and viroids infected tissue extracts and it provides a method for staining dsDNA, based on in-situ formation of uranyl-phosphate, that consistently permits examination of dsDNA by electron microscopy without heavy metal shadowing.

the method for staining dsRNAs, based on in-situ formation of uranyl phosphates, consistently permits the examination by electron microscopy of dsRNAs without shadowing with the heavy metals, and provides for the routine assays for dsRNAs in crude extracts without variable results associated with the shadowing procedures.
